description:
SOLD WITHIN 48 HOURS

Situated in the heart of the Dene area of the town with the Dene Park being a stones throw away and is close walking distance to the local Town centre , local schools, shops amenities, local train station with links across the north east and Darlington Memorial hospital. This two bedroom mid terrace property would ideally suit a wide range of buyers including investors and private buyers alike. The property briefly comprises of; entrance porch, leading into the hallway, lounge, dining room, kitchen, whilst to the first floor there are two bedrooms and family bathroom. Externally to the rear there is an enclosed courtyard area with brick built storage and outside working wc.

ENTRANCE PORCH Entrance via a upvc framed double glazed door.

ENTRANCE HALL With radiator, stairs access to the first floor.

LOUNGE With upvc framed double glazed bay window, radiator.

DINING ROOM With upvc framed double glazed window, radiator, feature built in storage cupboards to both alcoves, built in under stair storage cupboard.

KITCHEN With a range of built in base and wall units, laminate work surfaces, inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, tiling to splash and work surfaces, integrated oven and gas hob, plumbing for the automatic washing machine, radiator.

FIRST FLOOR

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

With radiator and loft access.

BEDROOM ONE A most spacious double bedroom with upvc framed double glazed window, radiator.

BEDROOM TWO With upvc framed double glazed window, radiator, built in robes / storage.

FAMILY BATHROOM

With a fitted white suite comprising of; panel bath with mains shower over, wash hand basin, wc, tiling to splash and vanity areas, built in storage cupboard housing the wall mounted combination gas central heating boiler, chrome radiator, tiled floor, upvc framed double glazed window.

EXTERNALLY To the rear is a wall enclosed courtyard for outdoor seating, with brick built storage and a working outdoor wc.
